name: LiD Koçu
data_safety_notes: LiD Koçu (com.lidkocu.app). Free version shows ads (contains ads = Yes); Premium (one-time in-app product 'premium', not a subscription) is ad-free. Data collected and shared: Device or other IDs (Advertising ID via AdMob; Firebase app instance ID via Analytics and Remote Config) - Advertising, Analytics, App functionality (remote config); App activity (events: mock test started/finished with score and pass flag, premium screen, purchase, rewarded watched, banner/interstitial events; user property ad group) - Analytics; Approximate location (from IP) - Advertising, Analytics; Purchase history handled by Google Play (entitlement only). No Crashlytics in code, so do NOT declare crash logs unless Crashlytics is added (AdMob/Firebase SDKs may still report diagnostics). Shared with Google as service provider. Encrypted in transit. No account. AD_ID permission declared. Target audience 18+; not for children. Study progress, answers, language and state are stored only on the device (not collected).
